label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Memorial Struggles for Top Stars
items.text: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy both struggled in the second round at the Memorial Tournament, with McIlroy shooting a 74 and Scheffler an even-par 72, sitting eight shots behind leader J.T. Poston.

items.headline: Nelly Korda’s Major Surge
items.text: Nelly Korda fired the lowest round of the day to surge into contention at the women's major, joining Alison Lee and Ruoning Yin atop the leaderboard.

items.headline: Michelle Wie West’s Peaceful Farewell
items.text: In her one-week return to major championship golf, Michelle Wie West exuded peace as she made a memorable farewell at the U.S. Women's Open.
